title: Student Attendance Record II
summary: Determine the number of valid attendance records of length n, where a valid record contains fewer than 2 'A' (absent) characters and does not contain 'LLL' (three consecutive late) sequences.
statement: Determine the number of valid attendance records of length n, where a valid record contains fewer than 2 'A' (absent) characters and does not contain 'LLL' (three consecutive late) sequences. The result should be given modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Valid records use A, L, P with fewer than two total A and no LLL substring.
hints: Only absence count and current trailing-late length affect future validity.
Maintain six states: zero/one absence crossed with late run zero, one, or two.
Append P, optionally A, or L when its state limit permits, reducing modulo each day.
The state captures every forbidden-pattern condition, and each appended character creates each valid record exactly once.
editorial: The state captures every forbidden-pattern condition, and each appended character creates each valid record exactly once.

tests.explanation: All nine length-two records except AA are valid.
A, L, and P are all valid one-day records.
